task: 77.44.7.D / EDT-039 invalid and unsupported persisted Page Action recovery
problem: An unsupported persisted Page Model interaction caused createEditorState to reject the entire page before the Inspector recovery UI could render. When directly rendered in isolation, the Inspector also gave no warning or removal action for an invalid saved interaction.

implementation.recovery_loading: Added allowInvalidPageInteractions as an opt-in Editor-state loading policy. Only the Page Model invalid-interaction diagnostic is filtered in this recovery path; normal state creation, validation and command/save/publish paths remain strict.
implementation.inspector: Shows an accessible alert explaining that the unsupported saved action is skipped by public rendering, and exposes an explicit removal control. Rendering preserves persisted content; selecting a valid action also explicitly replaces it.
implementation.security: No interaction executes unless it passes the shared action/event/target allowlist. The corrupt fixture uses a JavaScript payload and confirms the action has no Canvas/public attributes.
implementation.save_publish: The Chromium flow saves explicit repair as draft; it asserts publish=false and that the already-published version remains unchanged.
implementation.public_focus_first_paint: Moved public focus-state stylesheet injection before awaiting the independent presentation-token endpoint. This prevents keyboard focus styling from flashing the published baseline while token data is loading; the public page template has a versioned cache-bust for the updated renderer.
